strategy_roster.name: ADX Mean Reversion
strategy_roster.entry_long: adx(high,low,close,14) < sma(adx(high,low,close,14),20) - 2 * std(adx(high,low,close,14),20) and close < sma(close,20)
strategy_roster.notes: ADX(14) is compared with its SMA(20) and two-standard-deviation band exactly as documented, and close versus SMA(20) is the price filter. The source mentions a percent stop but supplies no numeric value; SMA length 20 is a fallback.

strategy_roster.name: Fuzzy Logic
strategy_roster.notes: Normalized RSI(14) supplies a 0-to-1 decision-score proxy and retains the documented 0.25 long threshold, exiting after recovery to 0.5. Williams, DeMarker, fuzzy memberships, and 60/20-point protection are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Choppiness Index Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: ATR(14) as a fraction of close approximates low and high choppiness, translating the 38.2/61.8 thresholds to 0.382/0.618; SMA(20) retains the trend direction. The exact Choppiness formula and unspecified stop are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Trend Type Indicator
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > sma(close,20) and adx(high,low,close,14) > 25 and atr(high,low,close,14) > sma(atr(high,low,close,14),20)
strategy_roster.notes: Price direction, ADX(14)>25, and ATR(14) above its 20-bar mean approximate a non-sideways bullish regime. +DI/-DI and the custom smoothed regime type are unavailable; no stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: Heiken Ashi Smoothed Trend
strategy_roster.notes: Crosses between EMA-smoothed close and open preserve the documented bullish/bearish color changes. Heiken-Ashi recursive construction is unavailable and EMA length 10 is a fallback because no value is supplied.

strategy_roster.name: Time Bomb
strategy_roster.notes: A one-bar rise above 1% is a price-normalized proxy for the five-pip move inside ten seconds because ticks and clocks are unavailable. The 20-pip stop and target are not percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Prop Firm Helper
strategy_roster.notes: A 20-period prior Donchian breakout enters and the opposite band represents the trailing exit. Channel periods, shifts, ATR stop movement, risk sizing, equity pass, and daily-loss rules are unavailable or unspecified.

strategy_roster.name: ComFracti Fractal RSI
strategy_roster.notes: A break above the prior five-bar low approximates a bullish fractal, and RSI(3) below 50-3 retains the daily RSI filter. Fractal shifts, multiple timeframes, expiry, and 2500/700-pip protection are not representable.

strategy_roster.name: Risk Monitor
strategy_roster.notes: The source intentionally never opens trades, so impossible price guards prevent a fabricated strategy entry. Account sizing, exposure, and realized/floating profit diagnostics are outside the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: RGT EA RSI
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14)<30 and a 20/2 lower-band close retain the documented long extreme, with middle-band recovery as exit. All thresholds, price-unit stops, and trailing parameters are absent and use explicit fallbacks.
